player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa co kwimuka gitegerezwa kuba mu buryo [macro micro] hamwe n'ibiharuro 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ibiharuro vyose bitegerezwa kuba biri hagati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ikarata micro_board, umurongo canke ikori biri hanze y'urugero.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Uwo mukinyi ategerezwa gukina ku kibaho gikurikira.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Urutonde rw'ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu gucuraranga ruramaze gutsindwa.

game_action.played: Munyokozi {player_id} arikoze muri micro board {macro_idx}, selule {micro_idx} (safu {row}, kolone {col}). Munyokozi {opponent_id} azakomeza kukoza muri {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umukinyi {player_id} aratsinda Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
